description: TwexAPI Twitter API profile with SDK, Skill, MCP, docs, and package links.
rules: Use README.md and profile/README.md as public indexes for TwexAPI SDK, skill, docs, and MCP links.
Use SECURITY.md and SUPPORT.md for public vulnerability and support reporting guidance.
Verify API behavior against TwexAPI source, OpenAPI, generated SDK maps, or public registry metadata before changing claims.
Publish Node packages under the @twexapi-dev npm scope.
Do not include API keys, private routing details, credentials, or unsupported package-health claims.
Do not claim webhook delivery, WOEID trends, or other capabilities not in the current OpenAPI.
